@{5f30a4580d85f347c361e55d|full_name}: To be fair, for my personal avatar, it really isn't much of an issue unless I'm laying down as well. When I'm standing up, I have to have my hand-wrist-arm at like an uncomfortable angle to get it to mess up like in your video. They'll try their best, but assumedly IK prediction can only work so far.
https://streamable.com/9cshvy

@{5ca74f3fb98a820b3ffec9cf|full_name}: In my case it's a bother because i have long hair so i keep doing that wrist movement above my shoulder of pulling away my hair, constantly, and you know that i also stream so everyone can see it haha, but then the other issue is when i'm laying down which also make the elbow go crazy in other ways
i also noticed the same behavior with the legs when you come too close to the ass

I made a feedback post but I guess it's already noted here - elbows either flare out way behind shoulder or they aggressively spaz out. With tweaks you can turn off elbow chest avoidance to stop the spazzing but the elbow flare still presists. Happens with every avatar I try even the vrchat defaults, not one works properly when comparing to legacy ik. For me personally it makes the new ik worse for general use than legacy, but I tend to like to dance in VR, a lot of people probably havent clocked how bad it really is. Video showing the issue https://youtu.be/Vw8OMG2gnCg also the pics, first is legacy, second is new ik, third is the position my arm is in for all the tests.

comments.mergedPostDetails: Im finding this is the case with every avatar I try, some worse than others. First image is legacy, second is the new IK. Elbows flare out backwards, it makes dancing awkard to say the least. I'm not sure what else to add to make the post more detailed. I really hope this is something being looked at, at this point I am unwilling to move away from legacy.

details:
I noticed if you put your controller near or on your shoulder, that the elbow starts to switch positions aggressively with the smallest bit of motion from the rest of the body. This happened with the same behavior on two different body bases, which lets me assume, it is a general issue with the beta IK. 
6 point with index.
Hight avatar scale and head-lock.
(need to test it tomorrow if it also happens in on the other settings and will make a video about it)
